heard: He was about thirty when the work began As it was supposed, He carried the name Son of Heli, Son of Mapheth, Son of Levi Walking the path that the ancestors knew From Elchi to Jannah, the line is drawn Through Joseph and Mattathias, the story grows Amos and Nahon, Esli and Naga Moth and Mattathias, names in the snow The son of Jonah The son of Reza
